description: Codex CLI (>=0.154) hooks for the Crosstalk bus. Copy into ~/.codex/hooks.json on an ENROLLED machine (machine-level, like the Claude plugin hooks) and replace <plugin-src> with the installed plugin's src dir (e.g. C:/Users/<you>/.claude/plugins/cache/crosstalk/crosstalk/<version>/src or ~/cross-claude-client/src) and <bash> with the bash to run codex-join.sh (Linux: bash; Windows: C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe — a bare `bash` may be WSL, which cannot see D:). Only `description` and `hooks` are valid top-level keys (Codex refuses the whole file otherwise). Commands are node one-liners because on Windows Codex runs hook commands through pwsh, where a leading quoted bash.exe path is a string expression rather than a command (the hook reports Failed and never runs); node spawns bash itself, which works under any launcher. Codex asks you to trust each hook ONCE via /hooks (hash-pinned; re-prompts after an edit). Same protocol as Claude Code hooks: stdin JSON with session_id, exit 2 blocks.
